tagline: Email and password breach lookup — Streamlit app and CLI
summary: Checks whether an email address or password appears in known data breaches, from either a Streamlit web interface or a command-line interface. Password checks use Have I Been Pwned's k-anonymity range endpoint, so only a five-character SHA-1 prefix is sent and the suffix is matched locally. The two email lookups send the full address to the upstream service.
highlights: Password checks use Have I Been Pwned's k-anonymity range endpoint: only the first five characters of the SHA-1 hash leave the machine, and the suffix is matched locally.
A single entry point serves both a Streamlit web interface and an argparse CLI.
Documents per endpoint which lookups transmit the full email address, rather than claiming blanket privacy.
